children: As at close of business on 28 August 2026, the unaudited ex-dividend Net Asset Value (“
”) for Hargreave Hale AIM VCT plc was 31.97 pence per Ordinary share.
The reported NAV is ex-dividend a special dividend of 0.75 pence per Ordinary share which will be paid on 30 September 2026 to those shareholders on the Company’s register on 21 August 2026.
The unaudited cum-dividend NAV was 32.72 pence per Ordinary share.
